brief: Owner report on v7.0.1 (tvofi 2026-10-19): cheap hours with comfort headroom are planned at a 25 C flow set-point (35 before #2445) and low-power slots fill the day. Root cause (measured on the owner's private export, synthetic fixtures only): (A) the heating floor inlet+5 K equals FLOW_GATE_C 25 whenever the tank is at or below 20 C, so a heating step at p_min writes the do-not-heat value; (B) draw_range engages on censored samples: no metered sample was ever taken at the ceiling set-point and the window's floor is idle draw (RUNNING_FLOOR_KW 0.25 below idle ~0.3 kW). Fix A: heating floor max(inlet, FLOW_GATE_C)+FLOW_MIN_LIFT_K. Fix B: store the written set-point per sample, max-end evidence only from ceiling-commanded samples, learned idle draw excludes idle samples. The #2065 7b clamp is NOT landed (circular on censored evidence). Controls: pins failing on main, mutation proof, flat-price null (byte-identical plans), duty-cycling null, relaxed-start control on an owner-shaped synthetic install.
